title: Are Verifier Errors Independent Within a GRPO Group? Evidence from Qwen2.5 Rollouts
abstract: arXiv:2609.06386v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Group-based reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) scoresmultiple completions per prompt using automatic verifiers. Analysesbased on independent verifier errors may overlook dependence associatedwith shared answer formats. We investigate this dependence in24,998 groups of eight completions generated by Qwen2.5-1.5B onMATH, GSM8K, and DeepMath-103K. We estimate a pooled within-groupverifier-error correlation of 0.530 (95% confidence interval:0.500--0.560). Under an exchangeable-error model, this correspondsto a design-effect-adjusted effective sample size of 1.70 for aneight-completion group. Dependence varies substantially across answerforms: fractions, radicals, symbolic expressions, and intervals exhibitstronger clustering than unit annotations and percent signs. Replayinggroup-relative advantages across four rule-based verifier configurationsidentifies at least one advantage-sign disagreement in up to 0.83% ofgroups. Be

translated_title: GRPO组内的验证器误差是否独立？来自Qwen2.5 rollout的证据
translated_abstract: 基于可验证奖励的群组强化学习（RLVR）使用自动验证器对每个提示的多个完成结果进行评分。基于独立验证器误差假设的分析可能忽略了与共享答案格式相关的依赖性。我们在由Qwen2.5-1.5B在MATH、GSM8K和DeepMath-103K上生成的24,998个组（每组八个完成结果）中研究了这种依赖性。我们估计汇总的组内验证器误差相关性为0.530（95%置信区间：0.500–0.560）。在可交换误差模型下，这对应于八完成组经设计效应调整后的有效样本量仅为1.70。依赖性在不同答案形式之间差异显著：分数、根式、符号表达式和区间表现出比单位标注和百分号更强的误差聚类。通过在四种基于规则的验证器配置下重放组相对优势，我们发现最多有0.83%的组存在至少一个优势符号不一致的情况。
tldr: 该研究发现GRPO组内的验证器误差并非独立——组内误差相关性高达0.530，使八个完成结果的有效样本量降至1.70，且这种依赖程度在不同答案形式间差异显著，表明假设验证器误差独立的分析可能存在系统性偏差。
en_tdlr: This study shows that verifier errors within GRPO groups are not independent—exhibiting a pooled within-group error correlation of 0.530 that reduces the effective sample size of an eight-completion group to just 1.70, with dependence varying substantially across answer formats, suggesting analyses assuming independent verifier errors may be systematically biased.
